title: Timing and Intrauterine Insemination in Unexplained Infertility
brief_summary: to determine the most suitable time for administration of (human chorionic gonadotropin )hCG prior to intrauterine insemination (IUI) to optimize pregnancy outcome and to have the best success rates so the cases divided in to four groups according to the time of hCG administration .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mild male infertility or unexplained infertility

Exclusion Criteria:

* Adanced male factor endometriosis uterine abnormality sever semen parameters i impairment according to WHO 2010 non ovulatory cycles bilatral tubal block
